meta_description: Find 72 Grand Piece Online music IDs for Music Snail. Search by title or artist, copy the number, and check Music Snail access before you try a song.
intro_md:
These 72 Grand Piece Online songs are Roblox audio tracks tied to the game. Search by title or artist, copy the number, and paste it into Music Snail's music field when the control accepts IDs.

Music Snail is a game-specific music item, so access and Roblox audio permissions matter as much as the number.
description_md:
## What a Grand Piece Online music ID is

A Grand Piece Online Music ID is the number for a Roblox audio track. It may be called a GPO song code, but it isn't a redeemable reward. It doesn't grant fruits, levels, weapons or crew benefits. Track details may include an artist, album, duration or cover art.

## Entering a Grand Piece Online music ID

1. Join [Grand Piece Online on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/games/1730877806/Grand-Piece-Online).
2. Check the in-game store for Music Snail access.
3. Equip Music Snail from your inventory when the item is available.
4. If the music field accepts IDs, paste the digits from the song and confirm.
5. Check the game's music setting and Roblox volume if you hear nothing.

The [Music Snail wiki page](https://grand-piece-online.fandom.com/wiki/Music_Snail) covers the item and its Roblox audio restrictions.
how_it_works_md:
## Troubleshooting a Music Snail song

- **Music Snail access is missing.** Recheck the store and your inventory before you assume the number is wrong.
- **The item or music field changed.** Follow the controls you see in the game.
- **Roblox restricted the audio.** Moderation, privacy, rights and creator settings can all stop a song from playing.
- **The ID has extra text.** Paste only the digits.
- **Volume is muted.** Check the game's music setting, Roblox volume and your device audio.

Try a second song, and confirm that Music Snail works at all. If the item opens but several songs fail, the audio permissions or input rules have probably changed.

faq_json.q: Where do I enter a Grand Piece Online Music ID?

faq_json.a: Music Snail is the game-specific music item you play these songs through. Check the in-game store and your inventory for access, because price and availability can change.
faq_json.q: What is Music Snail in GPO?

faq_json.a: The track may be unavailable, Music Snail access may be missing, the input rules may have changed, or audio may be muted. Try a second song and check the game's music setting.
faq_json.q: Why does a GPO song stay silent?

faq_json.a: Not necessarily. Being tied to the game doesn't make a song an official GPO recording or mean Music Snail accepts it today.
